description: Open and read one email in full (body and details) from your agent's mailbox. Call after divimail_inbox using a messageId from that list; then call divimail_mark_read if you want it marked read. Needs a token.

email.description: Your agent's full @divindi.io email address (e.g. myagent@divindi.io)

token.description: JWT token from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_read
